---
title: "For what purposes do you use generative AI tools?"
question_id: genAI2
---

```{r}
#| include: false
#| file: ../R/_load_common.R
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
question_code <- "genAI2"

nordic_countries <- c(
  "Finland", "Norway", "Sweden", "Denmark", "Iceland", "Estonia"
)
country_groups <- list(
  Nordics = nordic_countries,
  Germany = "Germany",
  Netherlands = "Netherlands"
)
plot_countries <- countries_from_groups(country_groups)
```

### Free-text responses

```{r}
#| echo: false
source(file.path(book_root, "R/recodes/genAI2_recode.R"))

data_coded <- process_text_codes_with_allocation(
  filter = FILTER,
  question_code = "genAI2",
  recode_map = genAI2_recode_map,
  header = "Usage of AI",
  other = TRUE,
  cache_id = "genAI2"
)

data_coded$summary_table
```

The raw-to-category allocation table for this question is in @sec-appendix-recoding.
